```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ISLR)
```
```{r}
library(MASS)
```
```{r}
data("Boston")
boston1=data.frame(Boston)
```

```{r}
view(boston1)
```

```{r}
dim(boston1)
```
```{r}
attach(boston1)
```

```{r}
crim_med=rep(0,nrow(boston1))
crim_med[boston1$crim>median(boston1$crim)]=1
boston1=data.frame(boston1,crim_med)
set.seed(312)
training_data=sample(nrow(boston1),size=0.75*nrow(boston1))
length(training_data)
```
```{r}
glm_fit = glm(crim_med ~ . - crim, data = boston1, subset = training_data, family = "binomial")
summary(glm_fit)
```
```{r}
glm_probs = predict(glm_fit, boston1[-training_data, ], type = "response")
glm_pred = rep("No", dim(boston1[-training_data, ])[1])
glm_pred[glm_probs > 0.5] = "Yes"
table(glm_pred, boston1[-training_data, "crim_med"], dnn = c("Predicted","Actual"))
```
